description: The sheriff's office is a wooden room divided between a working desk and iron-barred cells. The cells occupy the left and upper-left walls, while a desk covered with papers, an open book and small objects stands to the right. A green chair sits behind it, near a window, a flag and a wall map. Rifles are mounted farther along the right wall, beside a small sideboard. A dark stove stands at the lower-left side, and a round braided rug fills the open floor. Lamps cast warm light on the boards, turning a practical frontier office into a clearly furnished interior.

landmarks.label: Sheriff desk
landmarks.description: Papers, an open book and small objects cover the desk beneath the right-hand wall.

landmarks.label: Wall map and rifle rack
landmarks.description: A large map and mounted rifles hang above the work area.

landmarks.label: Office stove
landmarks.description: A dark metal stove and small stool sit near the lower-left wall.

landmarks.label: Braided circular rug
landmarks.description: A green-and-orange braided rug marks the open space in the middle of the floor.
